import.title: Import catalog
import.subtitle: Upload an Excel workbook with subjects, teachers and groups. You will see a preview first, and nothing is saved until you confirm.

contract.title: Workbook structure
contract.intro: The workbook must have these three sheets with these columns. Sheet and column names must match the template.
contract.legend: Columns marked as optional may be left empty. The order of the columns does not matter; their names do.

rules.noId: No Id column is accepted: sheets refer to each other by code, email or name.
rules.carreraExists: The Carrera of each subject must already exist in the system; the import does not create careers.
rules.horasPositive: HorasTotales must be a whole number greater than zero.
rules.periodoFormat: Periodo must use the format YYYY-S1 or YYYY-S2, for example 2026-S1.
rules.correoDocenteResolves: CorreoDocente, on the Grupos sheet, must match a teacher on the Docentes sheet or one already in the system.

upload.dropActive: Drop the file to see the preview

preview.title: Preview
preview.notSaved: Nothing has been saved yet. Review the result and confirm to apply the changes.
preview.accountsToCreate: {count, plural, =0 {No new teacher accounts will be created.} one {# new teacher account will be created.} other {# new teacher accounts will be created.}}
preview.accountsCost: Each new account generates a temporary password, so confirming takes longer the more accounts are created.
preview.deactivations: {count, plural, =0 {No group will be deactivated.} one {# group missing from the workbook will be deactivated.} other {# groups missing from the workbook will be deactivated.}}

errorsPanel.title: {count, plural, one {# error found in the workbook} other {# errors found in the workbook}}
errorsPanel.help: Fix the workbook and upload it again. It cannot be confirmed while there are errors.
errorsPanel.caption: Rows with errors

result.title: Import completed
result.accountsCreated: {count, plural, =0 {No new account was created.} one {# new account was created.} other {# new accounts were created.}}
result.accountsUpdated: {count, plural, =0 {No existing account was updated.} one {# existing account was updated.} other {# existing accounts were updated.}}

credentials.notice: This file contains the temporary passwords and is shown only now: it cannot be recovered later. Download it and keep it somewhere safe.
credentials.count: {count, plural, one {The file includes # account.} other {The file includes # accounts.}}
